name: get_company_info
description: The company: name, GSTIN, state, registration type, the first financial year of the books, and the working period and today’s date.

name: list_ledgers
description: Find ledgers (accounts) by name, group, GSTIN or PAN. Returns id, name and group — use the id with ledger_statement or draft_voucher.

search.description: Part of the name, group, GSTIN or PAN; omit for all ledgers

group.description: Only ledgers whose group name contains this, e.g. "Sundry Debtors" or "Bank"

name: ledger_statement
description: One ledger’s statement for a period: opening balance, each voucher (date, type, number, other side, debit, credit, running balance), totals and closing balance.

name: trial_balance
description: Trial balance as on a date: every ledger with a closing balance (debit or credit) and the totals.

name: profit_and_loss
description: Profit and loss for a period: trading section (opening/closing stock, sales, purchases, direct items, gross profit) and the P&L section (indirect incomes and expenses, net profit), by group and ledger.

name: balance_sheet
description: Balance sheet as on a date: liabilities and assets by group and ledger, the current period’s profit, and the totals.

name: outstandings
description: Bill-wise outstandings as on a date: receivables (what customers owe) or payables (what the company owes suppliers), by party with ageing buckets and the open bills.

name: search_books
description: Search the books (ledgers, stock items, vouchers) with the app’s search language: free words, and filters such as type:sales, party:"Name", amount>5000, date:2025-07, in:vouchers.

name: day_book
description: Every voucher in a period (all entries, like a day book): date, type, number, main account, narration and amount.

name: stock_summary
description: Stock summary as on a date: each item’s closing quantity and value (inventory valuation of the books).

name: gst_summary
description: GSTR-3B summary for one month as computed from the books: outward supplies and tax, reverse charge, eligible ITC and the net tax payable in cash.

name: tds_summary
description: TDS by section and quarter for a financial year: deductees, base amount, TDS deducted, booked to payable, deposited, allocated to challans.

fy.description: Financial year start, e.g. 2025 for FY 2025-26

quarter.description: 1 = Apr–Jun … 4 = Jan–Mar; omit for the whole year

name: current_screen_data
description: The data on the screen the user is looking at right now (from the screen context: screen, period, parameters) — the same rows the screen shows, capped. Use it for "this", "here" or "why is this high?" questions.

name: explain_figure
description: Explain one figure ("Explain this"): for a ledger — opening, debits, credits, closing, the largest vouchers and other-side ledgers with their share, the previous period and anomalies (outsized entries, possible duplicates, negative cash / bank); for a group or report line — the ledgers that make it up with shares and the previous period; for a voucher — its lines; for a stock item — its movements. Pass the ids and period from "Figure to explain"; omitted fields default to it.

groupName.description: A group or report line name, e.g. "Sales Accounts"; several joined by " + "

asOn.description: For balances as on a date (trial balance, balance sheet)

name: item_movements
description: One stock item’s movements for a period (stock movement register): opening, every inward / outward line with quantity and engine value, totals and closing quantity and value.

itemId.description: The stock item id (from stock_summary or search_books)

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

name: manufacture_register
description: Manufacture vouchers in a period: finished item, quantity, material / labour / by-product cost, production cost now vs at save, sale value and profit.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

name: trade_pending
description: Open trade documents as on a date, line by line with the pending quantity and value: delivery challans not yet invoiced, GRNs not yet billed, or pending sales / purchase orders.

asOn.description: As on (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

name: bank_unreconciled
description: Bank reconciliation for one bank ledger and period: balance as per books, unreconciled deposits and withdrawals (no bank date yet), and the balance as per bank, with the unreconciled entries.

ledgerId.description: The bank ledger; omit for the first bank ledger

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

name: tds_eligible
description: Vouchers in a period where TDS looks applicable but is not deducted (the TDS workbench): party, PAN, section, base, the effective rate and the suggested deduction, and why it is listed.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

name: forecast_summary
description: Cash-flow forecast from today (expected scenario, 13 weeks by default): opening cash and bank, per period inflow / outflow / closing, the lowest point, the first shortfall and the largest expected flows.

name: audit_log_recent
description: The latest audit-trail (edit log) entries: when, who, what (entity, action, reference). Optionally for one voucher or one entity kind.

name: close_checklist
description: The month-end close checklist for one month: each check (bank reconciliation, unallocated receipts/payments, overdue bills, GSTR-1/3B prepared, TDS/TCS deposited, negative stock, unbilled challans/GRNs, suspense, post-dated cheques, depreciation, regular expenses missing, blank narrations, rounding, open drafts, lock date) with its status (ok / warn / fail / done / na), a summary, the screen that fixes it and the first rows behind it.

period.description: The month (YYYY-MM); omit for the current one

name: gst_2b_mismatches
description: GSTR-2B vs the purchase register for one month, from the 2B JSON imported in the app: the mismatches by category (missing in books, missing in 2B, amount differs, period differs, GSTIN differs), each with the documents, the difference, a suggested action and whether a draft can be prepared (use draft_gst_2b_fix with its key).

period.description: The month (YYYY-MM); omit for the current one

name: find_anomalies
description: Unusual entries in a period: possible duplicates (same party and amount within days, same bill number, same narration and amount), large round amounts, ledger pairings never used before, amounts far above a party’s or ledger’s usual (z-score), weekend / holiday dates, back-dated entries, GST charged unlike the item rates and items of one HSN at different rates. Dismissed findings are left out. Each finding has a short letters-only `ref`: quote it to refer to a finding, and pass `refs` to look at just those findings again.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the working period

refs.description: Only the findings with these refs (from an earlier find_anomalies result)

name: draft_gst_2b_fix
description: Prepare (NOT save) the draft a GSTR-2B mismatch suggests — the purchase for an invoice missing in the books, or a debit note for an entry above what the supplier reported. Pass the mismatch key from gst_2b_mismatches. The user reviews and saves it in the voucher editor.

name: categorise_statement
description: Proposes, for each open (unmatched) line of an imported bank statement, the ledger and voucher kind it belongs to — from bank rules, the narrations of earlier matched lines and party names. Lines no rule places come back with `candidates`: pick ONLY from those. To draft one, call draft_voucher with kind payment / receipt / contra, the bank as the account, the line amount as given, and `statementLineId`. Nothing is posted.

bank.description: The bank account name, when the id is not known

name: draft_voucher
description: Prepare (NOT save) a payment, receipt, contra or journal voucher for the user to review — e.g. "pay Bharat Steel against bills P/12 and P/15 from HDFC", "journal: rent 25,000 Dr Rent Cr Landlord". A payment / receipt to a party can be given as party + account + amount and/or the bills it settles. Pass names, quantities, amounts and dates exactly as the user said them — the app resolves them (it never guesses between similar names: you get status "needs_clarification" with the candidates, and must ask the user). Never pass tax amounts or totals: GST, totals and bill amounts are computed by the app. The result is a DRAFT the user reviews in the editor; it is validated like a real save (locked period, credit hold, stock, links) and refused with the reason when it would not save.

kind.description: payment = money out of cash/bank; receipt = money in; contra = between cash and bank; journal = no cash/bank (e.g. an expense bill on credit)

voucherTypeId.description: A specific voucher type of that kind; omit for the default

date.description: The date as the user said it — "2025-07-31", "yesterday", "last Friday", "15 Aug"; the app resolves it against the working date. Omit for the working date.

ledgerId.description: A ledger id from an earlier tool result

ledger.description: Or the ledger name as the user said it

preferred.description: Or use the ledger the memory block remembers for this purpose (e.g. "payment" = the account payments are made from)

amount.description: Amount in rupees exactly as the user gave it, e.g. "5000", "12,500.50", "1.5 lakh" — never a figure you worked out

lines.description: Debit and credit lines (debits must equal credits). For a payment / receipt to a party you may instead give party + account + amount / bills.

party.description: Party name or GSTIN as the user said it (the app finds the ledger; omit when you pass partyLedgerId)

account.description: Payment / receipt: the cash or bank ledger, as said

amount.description: Payment / receipt amount; omit when it is "the bills" — the app adds up their pending amounts

bill.description: Bill / invoice number as the user said it

amount.description: Omit to settle the bill in full

bills.description: The party's open bills this settles (resolved against its outstandings)

oldestBillsFirst.description: Allocate the amount to the oldest open bills first

statementLineId.description: WP 5.4: the bank statement line (from categorise_statement) this voucher accounts for — it must post that line’s amount on its bank; saving the draft reconciles the line

name: draft_invoice
description: Prepare (NOT save) a sales invoice, purchase invoice, credit note or debit note with item lines — e.g. "sales invoice to Umbrella Retail for 2 Laptop 14 at 45,000". GST (CGST/SGST or IGST by place of supply), round-off and the total are computed by the invoice editor’s own calculation from the item masters; a note against an invoice links the returned lines and settles that bill. Pass names, quantities, amounts and dates exactly as the user said them — the app resolves them (it never guesses between similar names: you get status "needs_clarification" with the candidates, and must ask the user). Never pass tax amounts or totals: GST, totals and bill amounts are computed by the app. The result is a DRAFT the user reviews in the editor; it is validated like a real save (locked period, credit hold, stock, links) and refused with the reason when it would not save.

kind.description: sales invoice; purchase invoice (bill); credit note = sales return; debit note = purchase return

party.description: Party name or GSTIN as the user said it (the app finds the ledger; omit when you pass partyLedgerId)

date.description: The date as the user said it — "2025-07-31", "yesterday", "last Friday", "15 Aug"; the app resolves it against the working date. Omit for the working date.

account.description: Sales / purchase ledger, as said; omit for the usual one

item.description: Item name, barcode or HSN as the user said it

itemId.description: A stock item id from an earlier tool result

qty.description: Quantity as the user said it, e.g. "2" or "2.5"

rate.description: Rate per unit before tax, as the user said it; omit to use the price list / party rate

discount.description: Line discount in rupees, as said

discountPercent.description: Line discount as a percentage, e.g. "10%"

placeOfSupply.description: Only when the user names a state other than the party’s (code "29" or name)

billNo.description: Purchase: the supplier's invoice number (the bill name)

dueDate.description: Due date as said; omit for the party’s credit days

againstInvoice.description: Credit / debit note: the original invoice number it returns against

name: draft_stock_note
description: Prepare (NOT save) a delivery challan or a goods receipt note (GRN): a party, item lines and a purpose — goods move, nothing is posted to ledgers. Pass names, quantities, amounts and dates exactly as the user said them — the app resolves them (it never guesses between similar names: you get status "needs_clarification" with the candidates, and must ask the user). Never pass tax amounts or totals: GST, totals and bill amounts are computed by the app. The result is a DRAFT the user reviews in the editor; it is validated like a real save (locked period, credit hold, stock, links) and refused with the reason when it would not save.

kind.description: delivery_note = delivery challan (goods out); receipt_note = goods receipt note / GRN (goods in)

party.description: Party name or GSTIN as the user said it (the app finds the ledger; omit when you pass partyLedgerId)

date.description: The date as the user said it — "2025-07-31", "yesterday", "last Friday", "15 Aug"; the app resolves it against the working date. Omit for the working date.

purpose.description: Challan: supply, job_work, approval, liquid_gas, non_supply. GRN: purchase, job_work, return. Omit for supply / purchase.

item.description: Item name, barcode or HSN as the user said it

itemId.description: A stock item id from an earlier tool result

qty.description: Quantity as the user said it, e.g. "2" or "2.5"

rate.description: Rate per unit before tax, as the user said it; omit to use the price list / party rate

discount.description: Line discount in rupees, as said

discountPercent.description: Line discount as a percentage, e.g. "10%"

reference.description: Buyer's order no. / supplier's challan no.

name: draft_manufacture
description: Prepare (NOT save) a manufacture voucher: the finished item and quantity; raw materials come from its bill of materials scaled to the quantity, costed by the stock valuation engine. Pass names, quantities, amounts and dates exactly as the user said them — the app resolves them (it never guesses between similar names: you get status "needs_clarification" with the candidates, and must ask the user). Never pass tax amounts or totals: GST, totals and bill amounts are computed by the app. The result is a DRAFT the user reviews in the editor; it is validated like a real save (locked period, credit hold, stock, links) and refused with the reason when it would not save.

date.description: The date as the user said it — "2025-07-31", "yesterday", "last Friday", "15 Aug"; the app resolves it against the working date. Omit for the working date.

saleRate.description: Expected sale rate per unit (only for the profit line); omit for the average

components.description: Only when the item has no bill of materials (or the user lists different components)

name: draft_trade_doc
description: Prepare (NOT save) a quotation, sales order or purchase order with item lines; totals with GST through the invoice calculation. Pass names, quantities, amounts and dates exactly as the user said them — the app resolves them (it never guesses between similar names: you get status "needs_clarification" with the candidates, and must ask the user). Never pass tax amounts or totals: GST, totals and bill amounts are computed by the app. The result is a DRAFT the user reviews in the editor; it is validated like a real save (locked period, credit hold, stock, links) and refused with the reason when it would not save.

docTypeId.description: A specific numbering series (trade document type) id

series.description: Or the series name / prefix as the user said it; omit for the first series of the kind

party.description: Party name or GSTIN as the user said it (the app finds the ledger; omit when you pass partyLedgerId)

date.description: The date as the user said it — "2025-07-31", "yesterday", "last Friday", "15 Aug"; the app resolves it against the working date. Omit for the working date.

item.description: Item name, barcode or HSN as the user said it

itemId.description: A stock item id from an earlier tool result

qty.description: Quantity as the user said it, e.g. "2" or "2.5"

rate.description: Rate per unit before tax, as the user said it; omit to use the price list / party rate

discount.description: Line discount in rupees, as said

discountPercent.description: Line discount as a percentage, e.g. "10%"

dueDate.description: Order: expected delivery / receipt date, as said

name: remember
description: Propose (NOT save) a memory for this company — only something the user explicitly asked you to remember or stated as a standing preference in their message. It is stored as a suggestion the user accepts or dismisses; it never takes effect on its own. Never pass identifiers (GSTIN, PAN, bank account numbers).

kind.description: preference = a default ledger for a purpose; party = how a party is usually booked; style = how the user writes; fact = anything else they asked you to keep

text.description: One short sentence in the user’s own terms, e.g. "Ram Traders is always booked to Purchase A/c"

purpose.description: preference: what the ledger is for (payment = the cash/bank ledger payments are made from)

ledgerId.description: The ledger it is about: the preferred ledger, or a party’s usual ledger

billDay.description: party: the usual day of the month it bills

aspect.description: style: what the style is about

data.description: Ids from tool results that make it usable: purpose + ledgerId for a preference, partyLedgerId (+ ledgerId / itemId) for a party
